title: Constant weight code A(36,4,5)
statement: Find binary words of length 36, each with exactly 5 ones and any two differing in at least 4 positions, as many as possible: a lower bound on A(36,4,5). The best known lower bound in Andries Brouwer's table of constant weight codes is 11,032 (our code). A code with more words improves it.
submission: Text file: one word per line, the 5 positions of its ones, distinct integers from 1..36 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Andries Brouwer's table of constant weight codes (aeb.win.tue.nl/codes/Andw.html), A(36,4,5) >= 11,032: our code, listed since 2026-11-03 (before it 10,948); read 6 Nov 2026 13:28 UTC (page last modified 5 Nov 2026 22:34 GMT)
